plugins.name: review-cycle
plugins.description: The review role's state machine: idle -> scoped -> auditing -> reported. Per-requirement verdicts (Present, Surface, Absent, Incorrect) gate the move to reported; a standing refusal rule keeps the role from ever reading the building agent's intent or proposal prose.

plugins.name: review-agent-env
plugins.description: One-install environment bundle for the review role: installs review-cycle via dependency. Contains no code of its own.
